signal: Cube unveiled an AI-powered collaboration suite for business planning in June 2025, building on fresh funding for its FP&A platform

email.body1:
Benjamin, saw Cube unveil its AI-powered collaboration suite to transform business planning off the back of new funding.

A flagship launch usually means more finance teams worth reaching than the sales org can cover, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Cube off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Benjamin, quick follow-up for Cube.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Cube needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Benjamin, last bit of proof for Cube.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Cube's reply rate likely compares to peer finance-software startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Cube's motion? I'll tailor it to you either way.
